normalized_review.text: Recently I have availed Chimney deep clean service from UC on Nov 2nd. After 15 days of use, oil started dripping from outside indicating some leakage while reinstallation of chimney after service. The chimney was working perfectly fine for the last few years and just after the service the installation appears to be inappropriate. Now I cannot claim warranty as it was just valid for 10 days. I'm extremely unhappy as I already paid almost Rs 1400 and expected to book another paid service.

tags.unmet_need: proper chimney reinstallation without post-service leaks and reasonable warranty coverage
